registration_timing: An initial public-source search identifying a possible VSCO to VSXY ticker change occurred before this protocol; follow-up source retrieval and code/rehearsal occur after this registration. This is not a blind or historical trading study.
unchanged: All old tracked files, 156 sealed core files, RM1a signal, 10% budget, six RS1 cycles, prior full-exposure FAIL and no automatic promotion
identity_case: Review the one RA1 asset 404 against retained corporate-action data, issuer and SEC documents. A ticker rename alone is not a new stock or strategy exclusion. Record documentary mapping separately; do not silently replace symbols in the archived universe or modify RA1 admission rules.
network: GET-only issuer/SEC documentary sources and Paper asset metadata for the explicitly reviewed VSXY alias; no account/orders, live brokerage host, stock prices, paid sources or SOXL. Existing RA1 snapshots read-only. All raw documents and per-symbol evidence stay private work/.
identity_status: Current documentary evidence can explain a lookup failure, but cannot satisfy future formation-window review timestamps or certify all peers. No live-admissible identity packet or universe remapping is produced by this stage.
integration: Deterministic synthetic complete raw/adjusted data, nonconstant FF3 and multiple archived-style common-stock peers; real frozen SM1/RM1a feature and rank audits, RA1 admission, eight real journals, independent conservation audit. Synthetic dates include future registered sessions only as explicit test-clock fixtures, never prospective observations.
fixture_boundary: Only the cohort hash boundary may be substituted for a bounded synthetic cohort. No mocking feature, regression, rank, identity, snapshot, ledger-head or accounting validation. All source/evidence documents in the fixture are labelled synthetic, not filings or provider observations.
ledger_transition: New offline adapter binds the admitted manifest, sealed rank targets, eight pre-execution journal heads and supplied synthetic execution-close marks. Every case validates before writes. Stale heads, duplicate replay, modified plan, invalid/missing held/target prices or corporate-action uncertainty reject the transition. A partial multi-journal write must be visible and never automatically retried as complete.
rehearsal_cases: Initial nonempty entry for four selectors at 5/25bp, next-session mark, later cycle with existing holdings and unchanged sealed strategy, one retained holding absent from new targets, and negative missing-price/stale-head/plan-tamper/action-review cases. No return optimization or performance headline.
result: Engineering pass only; no orders, scheduler, new live signals, source authenticity attestation or forward performance. Documentary unresolved issues remain blockers.
